title: Show a data grid with programmatic filters in a form
summary: Opens a modal WinForms form owned by the Altium Designer window, with a data-bound grid filtered by code through DataView.RowFilter, and returns the same results as text when called without UI.
phrasings: open a WinForms dialog from an extension
show a modal form owned by Altium Designer
get the main window handle for a dialog owner

commands.name: ShowUI
commands.description: Show a customer grid filtered by code
commands.params: Filter=<None|Custom|Simple|Like|TwoField|Between|OnlyGrids|Group|List> (optional; also a description or an index 0-8)
